title: Prefix frequency lies in the prefix coordinates
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers, and let $U$ be a set of coordinates indexed by $0,\ldots,n-1$. The coordinates in $U$ whose indices are less than $k$ are contained in the set of all coordinates whose indices are less than $k$.
hypotheses_covered: $U$ is a finite set of coordinates indexed by $0,\ldots,n-1$
